text: どの　わざを　わすれさせたい？

structure.en: do you want to make it forget?

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means making or letting someone else do it. わすれさせる = 'make it forget'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it. わすれさせたい = 'want to make it forget'.
